title: OllamaSetupStatus
description: GET /setup/ollama and the answers of POST /setup/ollama/download and /cancel (B10 R3): whether a usable Ollama runs, and the download the game's dialog offers (R4).

state.description: running = a usable Ollama answers; outdated = one answers but is older than accept_from (the player has to update or close it); installed = a usable program is on disk but not running (ours starts by itself; the player's own (source external) only via POST /setup/ollama/start after consent); starting; missing = offer the download; downloading / verifying / installing; failed (error set; the download can be started again and continues).

source.description: external = the player's own Ollama; managed = the one the game loaded; null when none.

done_bytes.description: Bytes on disk so far (kept after a cancel: the next start continues).

includes.description: Other parts of the official archive the dialog names (they come with Ollama from its source; we do not redistribute them).

error.description: Stable code when state is failed: unsupported_platform, network, checksum_mismatch, bad_archive, disk, start_failed.
